rules.content: (?:durch den Richter(?:in)?|durch die Richterin(?:in)?)\s+((?:Dipl\.-Ing(?:in)?|DDr(?:\.in)?|Dr(?:\.in)?|Mag(?:\.Dr)?|Mag\.a|Univ\.-Prof(?:in)?|Priv\.-Doz(?:in)?|Hon\.-Prof(?:in)?|Prim\.)?\s+(?:[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+(?:[-][A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)*(?:[ ]+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)+)(?:[ ]+(?:LLM|MBA|M\.Sc|M\.A|M\.B\.L|M\.B\.L\.M|M.Sc|r er nat|r er pol|r er iur\.Bakk|r er nat|r er pol|r er iur\.Bakk\. techn|r er iur\.Bakk\. phil|r er iur\.BEd|r er iur\.LLB|r er iur\.BA|Bakk\. iur|Bakk\. art|Bakk\. techn|Mag\.a|\u00d6kR|VetR|OMedR|StR|OStR|MedR|Techn R|KzlR|HR))*)

rules.name: names_after_verb_direct_object
rules.description: Matches person names appearing as direct objects of verbs like 'besitzt', 'hat', 'kennt', etc., capturing full names including suffixes.

rules.name: names_after_richter_complex_titles
rules.description: Captures full names with complex titles (e.g., Hon.-Prof., Priv.-Doz.in, OSR, Techn R) immediately following 'durch den Richter' or 'durch die Richterin', ensuring suffixes like 'Bakk. phil.' are included.
rules.content: (?:durch den Richter(?:in)?|durch die Richterin(?:in)?)\s+((?:Dipl\.-Ing(?:in)?|DDr(?:\.in)?|Dr(?:\.in)?|Mag(?:\.Dr)?|Mag\.a|Univ\.-Prof(?:in)?|Priv\.-Doz(?:in)?|Hon\.-Prof(?:in)?|Prim\.|OSR|OStR|StR|RgR|KommR|OMedR|MedR|Techn R|KzlR|HR)\s+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+(?:[-][A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)*(?:[ ]+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)*(?:[ ]+(?:LLM|MBA|M\.Sc|M\.A|M\.B\.L|M\.B\.L\.M|M\.Sc|r er nat|r er pol|r er iur\.Bakk|r er nat|r er pol|r er iur\.Bakk\. techn|r er iur\.Bakk\. phil|r er iur\.BEd|r er iur\.LLB|r er iur\.BA|Bakk\. iur|Bakk\. art|Bakk\. techn|Mag\.a|\u00d6kR))*)

rules.name: abbreviation_person_names_refined
rules.description: Matches single letter initials (e.g., M., J.N.) or specific known abbreviations in legal contexts, strictly requiring a following full name or specific legal context to avoid matching section headers like 'I.' or 'B.'.
